infotexts.JobDescription.captain_arcane: Reads star charts like navigation maps and treats fate as a current. Keeps the captain talent tree and gains an additional astral branch.
infotexts.JobDescription.captain_mystic: The deep answers every name, as long as you can pay. Keeps the captain talent tree and gains an additional abyssal branch.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Captain_Arcane_: Hold in both hands and press Use or Aim. Requires a vanilla captain with both primary talent stages completed, Helm skill 80, and Magic skill 60. Consumed only on success. Registers the Astral Captain transition. Applies next round, or to a newly spawned captain body after death. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Captain_Mystic_: Hold in both hands and press Use or Aim. Requires a vanilla captain with both primary talent stages completed, Helm skill 80, and Weapons skill 60. Consumed only on success. Registers the Abyssal Captain transition. Applies next round, or to a newly spawned captain body after death. One completed transition per player per campaign.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_AstralCaptain_T: Turret power consumption -10%; turrets you operate deal +10% damage.
When you give an order to another crew member, gain 30 Helm skill for 10 seconds.
When all missions are completed with no crew deaths, all crew gain +0.5 to all six skills, including Magic.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_AbyssalCaptain_: +15% damage to monsters; damaging humans inflicts bleeding.
+15% damage with hand cannons and pistols.
25% chance to gain a commendation on kill, up to 4 per round.
Crafted items gain +1 quality; skill gain speed +30%.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Captain_Talent0: +5% all attack damage, and you can drag creatures at full speed. Each point of Helm skill grants 0.1% max health, up to +20%.
